cases.purpose: An exact Asset Move covered field-for-field by its capability is accepted.
An exact Core Rights Delta covered field-for-field by its capability is accepted.
An exact finite Profile Operation covered by its capability is accepted.
A same-segment Asset Move followed by its exact temporary obligation and exact observed return is accepted.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized native source.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized source Domain Revision.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized destination Domain Revision.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized Asset Profile.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized native asset.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized recipient.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized gross debit.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized minimum spendable credit.
An Asset Move cannot widen its capability-authorized external withholding ceiling.
A Core Rights Delta cannot widen its capability-authorized right identity.
A Core Rights Delta cannot widen its capability-authorized authenticated subject.
A Core Rights Delta cannot widen its capability-authorized recipient.
A Core Rights Delta cannot widen its capability-authorized direction.
A Core Rights Delta cannot widen its capability-authorized backing Domain Revision.
A Core Rights Delta cannot widen its capability-authorized custody profile.
A Core Rights Delta cannot widen its capability-authorized exit profile.
A Core Rights Delta cannot widen its capability-authorized amount.
A Profile Operation cannot change its capability-authorized profile_id.
A Profile Operation cannot change its capability-authorized operation_id.
A Profile Operation cannot change its capability-authorized operation_target_id.
A Profile Operation cannot change its capability-authorized protected_profile_component_revision_id.
A Profile Operation cannot change its capability-authorized parameters_digest.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized paired_asset_move_occurrence_id.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized session_id.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized opening_segment.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized opening_ordinal.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized close_by_segment_ordinal.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized source_domain_revision_id.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized native_asset_id.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized asset_profile_id.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized obligated_actor_id.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized return_destination_id.
A temporary obligation cannot change its capability-authorized return_condition.
A temporary obligation cannot exceed its capability amount.
The paired Asset Move must precede the obligation in the same segment.
The paired Asset Move must deliver to the obligated actor.
A closure must be observed from the obligated actor.
A closure must return to the exact protected destination.
A closure must match the exact obligation asset and profile.
A closure after the exact close-by segment is rejected.
A temporary obligation is unavailable in an atomic plan.
An unknown protected identifier fails closed.
An Engine-defined opaque effect remains outside the protected plane.
A protected Effect without its exact capability is rejected.
A generic external call cannot enter the protected algebra.
An Engine cannot propose a Core-derived Effect.
Effect occurrence IDs are unique.
One native source cannot alias two Domain Revisions for the same asset and profile.
One closure cannot net multiple obligation keys.
Effect occurrence count is bounded before execution.
Repeated use of one capability cannot exceed its cumulative maximum.
